name: detail-synthesis
description: U12 materialized: deterministic, hash-seeded detail synthesis in the DECODER. Frequencies past the coded band are filled in with pseudo-random signs whose amplitude continues the coded band's own spectral decay. Costs zero bytes. The format's measured weakness is structural (it wins dE00 and loses SSIMULACRA2/DSSIM to WebP and lqip-modern above ~84 B), so SSIM2/DSSIM are the metrics to watch here, not dE00 - synthesized detail is uncorrelated with the true detail and must cost dE00.
